business_problem: Plabook needed to automate labor-intensive reading assessments so teachers could evaluate oral reading fluency and related literacy skills without spending hours on repeated manual running records.
solution_summary: Plabook built its reading platform around NVIDIA speech AI so children can read aloud and receive immediate assessment instead of waiting for teachers to manually score paper running records. Data Monsters used the NVIDIA Riva Speech AI SDK to train and deploy recognition models on voice recordings from hundreds of children with different accents and reading levels. In production, the application listens to oral reading, scores phoneme-level accuracy, flags errors in real time, and generates a digital running record that teachers only need to review. The result is a classroom workflow that compresses recurring literacy assessments from hours of teacher effort into minutes while still supporting oral fluency, dyslexia screening, comprehension, and phonemic-awareness tasks inside one platform.

Plabook, an intelligent platform that helps students learn to read, automates reading assessments, such as oral reading fluency, dyslexia screening, running records, comprehension, and phonemic awareness.

Data Monsters used the NVIDIA Riva Speech AI SDK to build accurate speech capabilities into the Plabook application with voice recordings from hundreds of kids with varying accents and reading levels.
The process requires minutes, versus hours, of a teacher's time for an entire class.
